Vancouver	allowed with approval

no development permit for a compliant solar collector (ZB 20001 s. 7.120 cl. 3.7); collectors must stay inside the roof edge; the 1.5 m height allowance is written for residential zones only, so industrial zones are not addressed — City to confirm (s. 5.10 cl. 11); self-supply exempt only when used on the property (EUA s. 2(1)(b), consolidated 2026); anything leaving the site goes through the power pool (s. 18(2)) or micro-generation ≤5 MW
